notes.title: ATTENTION TO DETAILS
notes.content:
We paid particular attention to the aircrafts involved in the scenario.
In specific:

- for the DC-9 interiors we carried out a thorough research, with several difficulties in finding the right materials;

- the aircraft firing the missile is deliberately unrecognizable (parts of different planes have been used), because it is not yet confirmed who launched it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270734/83278d1f86db1cacf11017c21d06265279e2afdc.png[/img]

>>> Release date: August 29th, 2018 on PC Windows and MAC (with Oculus / HTC VR support).

>>> Beta version available on Steam!
Ask us a Steam key to download the game and help us testing!
